4abd26513c.why: The eight qword loads, unpacks, and arbitrary word products all contribute to the live result, and SSE2 cannot combine the required modular and saturating arithmetic.

083a8559c5.why: The SSE2 filter arithmetic is required, and the separate qword destination load preserves both the permitted access width and the upper bytes of the live xmm0 result.

5a2765210f.why: The block already uses paired saturating byte products and rounded multiplication, with every qword load and unpack contributing to the live packed result.

696176e79d.why: The SSSE3 filter is already compact, and averaging requires the separate qword destination load to preserve the access width and the full xmm0 result.

8c61a2b734.why: Both halves require the two-operand unpack copies, and folding the unaligned source loads into legacy SSSE3 memory operands would introduce an unsupported alignment requirement.

9e07fb49dc.why: The two-operand unpacks need their copies, the unaligned input loads cannot safely become legacy SSSE3 arithmetic memory operands, and the destination load is already folded into pavgb.
